{{Dialogue|Soldier|Sir, we're receiving reports of Rebel activity in the islands of Montrosa.|Belladar|Are you certain, soldier?|Soldier|Yes, Governor.|Belladar|Lord Vader, I just received some terrible news.|Vader|Governor Belladar, my patience is wearing thin.|attr=The Reythan soldier, Belladar, and Vader|audio=BelladarsBadNews.flac|src=<ref name="gb">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''soldier''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reytha]] served under [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Antes Belladar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He warned Governor Belladar of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity on the planet during a visit from the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].
